name: LocationCoordinates
summary: Simple object holding the data for a location update.

properties.name: accuracy
properties.summary: Accuracy of the location update, in meters.

properties.name: altitude
properties.summary: Altitude of the location update, in meters.

properties.name: altitudeAccuracy
properties.summary: Vertical accuracy of the location update, in meters.

properties.name: floor
properties.summary: The floor of the building on which the user is located.

inlined.name: LocationCoordinatesFloor
inlined.summary: Simple object holding floor of the building on which the user is located.

properties.name: level
properties.summary: The logical floor of the building.
properties.description:
Level values represent logical levels above or below ground level and are not
intended to correspond to any numbering scheme in use by the building itself.
The ground floor of a building is always represented by the value 0. Floors
above the ground floor are represented by positive integers, so a value of 1
represents the floor above ground level, a value of 2 represents two floors
above ground level, and so on. Floors below the ground floor are represented
by corresponding negative integers, with a value of -1 representing the floor
immediately below ground level and so on.

properties.name: heading
properties.summary:
Compass heading, in degrees. May be unknown if device is not moving. On
iOS, a negative value indicates that the heading data is not valid.

properties.name: latitude
properties.summary: Latitude of the location update, in decimal degrees.

properties.name: longitude
properties.summary: Longitude of the location update, in decimal degrees.

properties.name: speed
properties.summary:
Current speed in meters/second. On iOS, a negative value indicates that the
heading data is not valid or the accuracy is configured incorrectly.
Note: Due to the Apple Geolocation API, set the [Titanium.Geolocation.accuracy](api:Titanium.Geolocation#accuracy)
property to [Titanium.Geolocation.ACCURACY_BEST_FOR_NAVIGATION](api:Titanium.Geolocation#ACCURACY_BEST_FOR_NAVIGATION) in order to properly
measure speed changes and prevent the app from returning negative values.

properties.name: timestamp
properties.summary: Timestamp for this location update, in milliseconds.
